snippet.title: Where the Wild Things Are - Xbox 360 / Ps3 Gameplay (2009)
snippet.description:
Where the Wild Things Are - Xbox 360 / Ps3 Gameplay (2009)

Subscribe: http://goo.gl/01dGfm


Where the Wild Things Are is a video game, released on October 13, 2009 in North America, November 25, 2009 in Australia and November 27, 2009 in Europe. It is based on the film of the same name, released the same day. The game is available for all seventh generation consoles: PlayStation 3, Wii and Xbox 360 as well as Nintendo DS. It was developed by Griptonite Games, except for the Nintendo DS which was developed by WayForward Technologies. All versions were published by Warner Bros. Games.


Recorded by Elgato Game Capture HD
